units.source_text: “然后，我又折回来，立即烧线香熏房间。

en.t: Then I turned back again and immediately burned incense to fumigate the room.

units.source_text: 以前这家是名门，按理说不会有这种东西的（指怪兽）。

en.t: This household used to be a distinguished family, so by rights there should not have been such a thing here (meaning the monster).

units.source_text: 再说，它干吗无缘无故地伤人呢？

en.t: Besides, why would it hurt people for no reason?

units.source_text: 于是我这样说：要是想喝想吃就说一声，我们给送去。

en.t: So I said this: if you want something to drink or eat, just say so, and we will bring it to you.
Please leave at once, please leave.

units.source_text: 我想说明道理，把它请出去。

en.t: I wanted to reason with it and ask it to leave.

units.source_text: 从明天起，我在房间西北角上供奉茶和饭。

en.t: Starting tomorrow, I will offer tea and rice in the northwest corner of the room.

units.source_text: 为了避邪，请你从仓库里拿一把刀来，拔出刀鞘，放在卧铺底下。

en.t: To ward off evil, please bring a knife from the storehouse, draw it from its sheath, and place it under the bed.

units.source_text: 然后，明天我再去问一遍狐仙看看。”

en.t: Then tomorrow I will go and ask the fox spirit once more.”
